name: Toolbar widgets
author: Brett
description: Attach any widget to any toolbar, banner style (toolbar-widgets@1): the same widgets the banner takes, any banner widget style and shape, snapped to the toolbar's ends so nothing overlaps. Right-click or long-press a toolbar → Attach widget…, a widget → Style… / Move / Detach; drag a widget onto any toolbar; the toolbar's settings → Widgets. Over REST (/api/plugins/toolbar-widgets/widgets…), the MCP tools toolbar_widgets_*, `axf toolbar-widgets …` / `axf toolbar widgets …` and AmberX voice, all through console-control@1.

items.title: Widgets on toolbars
items.description: One toolbar's widgets (toolbar=<id>: every row drawn / hidden / addable with size, show, shape, side and place, the person's slots and the style defaults), or every toolbar's widget targets.

toolbar.description: the toolbar's settings id (app, gate.auto-lander, ui-review.sections)

to.description: recent (default), all, or a console client id

items.output: console-control@1 state { value: toolbar-widgets@1 { toolbar, rows, slots, style, keys } } or list { targets }

items.title: Attach a widget to a toolbar
items.description: Put a widget on a toolbar at its start or end, optionally with a banner widget size and a shape.

toolbar.description: the toolbar's settings id (app, gate.auto-lander, ui-review.sections)

shape.description: shape id (circle, pill, rounded, squircle, square, …)

to.description: recent (default), all, or a console client id

items.title: Detach a widget from a toolbar
items.description: Take a widget off a toolbar (one the toolbar or a plugin put there is hidden and can be shown again). Destructive: needs confirm.

toolbar.description: the toolbar's settings id (app, gate.auto-lander, ui-review.sections)

to.description: recent (default), all, or a console client id

items.title: Move a widget on a toolbar
items.description: Move a widget to a side at a place (0 = first), or one place left / right.

toolbar.description: the toolbar's settings id (app, gate.auto-lander, ui-review.sections)

to.description: recent (default), all, or a console client id

items.title: Style a toolbar widget
items.description: Change one banner widget setting of a widget on a toolbar: size, show, priority, hideWhenEmpty, overflow, hidden, shape or label (no value = back to the default).

toolbar.description: the toolbar's settings id (app, gate.auto-lander, ui-review.sections)

to.description: recent (default), all, or a console client id

items.title: Open a toolbar's widgets
items.description: Open the Toolbar widgets dialog in the open console (on one widget when widget is given). Only navigates.

toolbar.description: the toolbar's settings id (app, gate.auto-lander, ui-review.sections)

to.description: recent (default), all, or a console client id
